description: Create a new page: unpublished, with no blocks, inheriting its ancestors' layout. Refused when the full slug path is already in use or the organization's page limit is reached, so it is not idempotent - to change an existing page, use update_page_settings. Add blocks with add_block_to_page, then publish_page - the site answers 404 for an unpublished page. Returns the new page's id and name.

customFields.description: Custom field values [{ fieldKey, value }] for the page type's schema - read it with get_page_type

description.description: Internal page description, separate from seoDescription

name.description: The page's internal name. Also the default display name in the workspace's default language when displayName is omitted

pageType.description: Page type slug from list_page_types (defaults to 'page')

parentId.description: Parent page id or slug. Omitted, the page goes under the home page when one exists

slug.description: Leaf slug segment, e.g. 'about-us'; '/' creates the home page. The stored slug is the full path under the parent

name: create_page
title: Create page
